Class PassAPI

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.pass.api.PassAPI
public final class PassAPI extends Object
The battle pass, for other plugins: give XP for what players do in your plugin, read their tier, and hear when they reach one. Declare "AtomicTempest:Pass": "*" under OptionalDependencies (and check isAvailable()) or Dependencies in your manifest.json. 
// Whenever a player wins an arena match:
PassAPI.addXp(playerUuid, 50);
PassAPI.onTier((player, tier) -> { ... });
Everything here is safe to call from any thread.
